clauses.quote: the regular teacher shall be free to pursue professional duties elsewhere on site or other district facilities.
The flexible duty day will be adjusted when night or weekend activities require attendance, or when tasks or assignments substantially extend the work day and/or work week.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management duty to adjust schedule based on extended activities.

clauses.quote: Alternative flexible duty day schedules may be made by unit members at the affected sites.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; authorizes union members to propose alternative schedules.

clauses.quote: School Site Councils shall set their own schedules
School Site Councils are not subject to limitations of Article VIII.
clauses.notes: Split from compound sentence; exemption from contractual limits.

clauses.quote: The flexible duty day for unit members whose primary responsibilities are task-oriented shall normally be seven and one-half (7½) hours per day on site excluding lunch.
clauses.subject_text: The flexible duty day for unit members whose primary responsibilities are task-oriented
clauses.notes: Defines guaranteed duty-hour cap for task-oriented roles.

clauses.quote: task-oriented unit members may complete their responsibilities at a location other than their site(s) if they have the necessary materials and equipment to enable them to do so.

Required service rendered for student activities that extend one hour after the close of the normal instructional day for the large majority of unit members at that site shall be paid in accordance with wage rates in Article VII for that period of time beyond one hour after the close of the normal instructional day.
clauses.subject_text: Required service rendered for student activities that extend one hour after the close of the normal instructional day for the large majority of unit members at that site
clauses.notes: Passive voice; mandates extra pay for extended student activities.

clauses.quote: Each unit member shall daily indicate that he/she has reported for and left from duty.
The method is to be determined by the site administrator with input from the staff.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; 'is to be' functions as obligation.
